projects.name: antman-compression
projects.title: Antman — Multi-Format Lossless Data Compression
projects.summary: Custom lossless data compression and decompression engine targeting text, HTML, and PBM image data via dictionary encoding and frequency-based bit packing.

projects.name: bistromatic
projects.title: Bistromatic — Arbitrary-Precision BigInt Arithmetic Engine
projects.summary: Bistromatic evaluates deeply nested arithmetic expressions involving numbers of infinite length (constrained only by available system RAM). It features custom big-integer addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and modulo routines, paired with an operator-precedence expression evaluator.

projects.name: bsq
projects.title: BSQ — Dynamic Programming Maximal Square Finder
projects.summary: High-performance 2D grid processing algorithm finding the largest unobstructed square on a map containing arbitrary obstacles.

projects.name: cryptography
projects.title: Cryptography — Symmetric & Asymmetric Cipher Toolkit
projects.summary: This repository provides foundational implementations of both symmetric and asymmetric encryption schemes. It emphasizes clean mathematical formulations, modular arithmetic operations, and cryptanalytic tooling to demonstrate vulnerability vectors in weak cipher designs.

projects.name: dante-star
projects.title: Dante's Star — Maze Generator & A* / Dijkstra Pathfinding Engine
projects.summary: High-throughput maze generator creating perfect and imperfect 2D labyrinths paired with optimized A* and Dijkstra pathfinding solvers.

projects.name: evalexpr
projects.title: EvalExpr — Recursive Descent Expression Parser & AST Evaluation
projects.summary: EvalExpr computes mathematical expressions directly from a character string. By utilizing a recursive descent grammar parser, it eliminates the need for external parsing generators or postfix conversion passes, evaluating values in a single recursive traversal.

projects.name: fastatools
projects.title: FASTAtools — Genomic Sequence Analysis & k-mer Toolkit
projects.summary: High-throughput bioinformatics command-line utility analyzing FASTA-formatted DNA and RNA sequences, computing k-mer frequencies, and detecting coding sequences.

projects.name: gomoku-ai
projects.title: Gomoku AI — Tournament Adversarial Game Engine
projects.summary: High-performance Gomoku (Five-in-a-Row) game engine designed for competitive tournament play under the Gomocup protocol. Employs Minimax search with Alpha-Beta pruning, bitboard representations, and heuristic pattern evaluation.

projects.name: infinadd
projects.title: InfinAdd — Arbitrary-Precision BigInt Arithmetic Engine
projects.summary: Arbitrary-precision arithmetic utility performing addition and subtraction on arbitrarily long numerical strings beyond hardware register bounds.

projects.name: lemin
projects.title: Lem-In — Network Flow Pathfinding & Graph Optimization
projects.summary: Graph optimization engine solving maximum network flow problems for ant colony routing through a network of connected rooms and tunnels.

projects.name: n4s-autonomous
projects.title: Need4Stek — Autonomous Vehicle Lidar Controller
projects.summary: Autonomous vehicle control algorithm driving a simulated car through complex tracks by analyzing real-time 32-beam lidar distance streams and computing adaptive PID steering and speed commands.

projects.name: neural-network
projects.title: Neural Network — Multi-Layer Perceptron & Gradient Descent from Scratch
projects.summary: This project implements a multi-layer feedforward perceptron designed for classification and regression tasks. It implements matrix mathematical operations, activation functions, and reverse-mode automatic differentiation (backpropagation) to optimize network weights via stochastic gradient descent.

projects.name: pushswap
projects.title: Pushswap — Constrained Double-Stack Sorting Optimization
projects.summary: Highly constrained algorithmic sorting challenge sorting a list of integers across two stacks (l_a and l_b) using a restricted instruction set (sa, sb, pa, pb, ra, rb, rra, rrb).

projects.name: sokoban
projects.title: Sokoban — Terminal Warehouse Puzzle Engine
projects.summary: Terminal warehouse box-pushing puzzle engine featuring map validation, real-time keyboard interaction, collision detection, and win/loss condition tracking.

projects.name: trade
projects.title: Trade — Real-Time Algorithmic Trading Bot & Market Signal Analysis
projects.summary: Trade interacts with simulated or live market exchange APIs, processing tick and candlestick data in real time. It computes technical indicators across rolling windows to detect momentum shifts, trend reversals, and breakout opportunities, automatically issuing market and limit orders.

projects.name: silicium-eip
projects.title: Silicium Network — Decentralized IoT Compute & ELF Partitioner
projects.summary: High-throughput distributed computing protocol harnessing low-power IoT devices via Solana and Anchor. Features a containerized C++ ELF binary partitioner and recursive task delegation protocols.

projects.name: c-pool
projects.title: C Systems Programming Foundations & Algorithms
projects.summary: Comprehensive foundational implementation suite covering standard C library recreation, memory manipulation, string algorithms, linked structures, and binary utilities.

projects.name: cpp-pool
projects.title: Modern C++ Object-Oriented Systems & Templates
projects.summary: Modern C++ progression covering RAII resource management, object-oriented encapsulation, polymorphism, operator overloading, and template metaprogramming.

projects.name: myftp
projects.title: myFTP — RFC 959 BSD Socket FTP Server
projects.summary: RFC 959-compliant File Transfer Protocol (FTP) server supporting concurrent multi-client connections over TCP/IP sockets with passive and active data transmission modes.

projects.name: panoramix
projects.title: Panoramix — Concurrent Multithreading & Semaphore Synchronization
projects.summary: Multi-threaded synchronization engine modeling the classic Sleeping Druid / Hungry Villagers concurrency problem using POSIX threads, mutexes, and semaphores.

projects.name: popeye
projects.title: Popeye — Multi-Service Microservices Containerization
projects.summary: Enterprise multi-service voting application containerized using Docker, Docker Compose, and multi-stage container builds.

projects.name: the-plazza
projects.title: The Plazza — Concurrency, Multiprocess IPC & Dynamic Thread Pools
projects.summary: The Plazza simulates a high-throughput order dispatching and processing facility. A main reception engine receives order inputs, analyzes workload metrics, and dynamically spawns kitchen subprocesses. Each kitchen manages a fixed thread pool to cook items concurrently while IPC channels maintain bidirectional state synchronization.

projects.name: zappy
projects.title: Zappy — High-Throughput Networked Simulation & Autonomous AI Protocol
projects.summary: Zappy models an alien civilization surviving on a grid-based resource world (`Trantor`). The system comprises three independently communicating components synchronized via a strict custom TCP protocol:

projects.name: 109titration
projects.title: 109titration — Chemical pH Curve Numerical Derivative Analysis
projects.summary: Computational chemistry utility calculating equivalence points in acid-base titration experiments using cubic spline interpolation and numerical differentiation.

projects.name: groundhog
projects.title: Groundhog — Real-Time Financial & Environmental Trend Analysis
projects.summary: Real-time rolling telemetry stream processor detecting trend switches, standard deviations, and temperature switches across temporal data feeds.

projects.name: math-algorithms
projects.title: Numerical Mathematics & Scientific Algorithms
projects.summary: Collection of applied numerical computing and scientific calculation utilities in Python and C.

projects.name: palindrome
projects.title: Palindrome — Numerical Base Transformation & Palindrome Solver
projects.summary: Number theory utility computing forward and reverse palindrome iteration counts across various numerical bases (from base 2 to base 36).

projects.name: projtester
projects.title: ProjTester — Automated Binary Integration Testing Framework
projects.summary: Automated black-box test runner validating binary standard output, error streams, and exit codes against expected reference specifications.

projects.name: sbmlparser
projects.title: SBML Parser — Systems Biology Markup Language Analyzer
projects.summary: XML lexical parser and analyzer for Systems Biology Markup Language (SBML) files, extracting biochemical species, compartments, and kinetic reactions.

projects.name: arcade
projects.title: Arcade — Modular Gaming Platform & Dynamic Graphic Libraries
projects.summary: Arcade solves the problem of cross-toolkit graphics abstraction by operating entirely through dynamic shared libraries loaded at runtime (`dlopen(3)`, `dlsym(3)`). The core engine manages event dispatching and entity states, allowing users to switch graphic libraries (e.g. from SFML to SDL2 or an NCurses terminal interface) and game cartridges (Snake, Nibbler, Pacman) on the fly without restarting or recompiling.

projects.name: myhunter
projects.title: myHunter — 2D Arcade Game Engine & Sprite Animation
projects.summary: 2D Arcade shooter featuring hardware-accelerated sprite animation, event-driven user interaction, frame rate regulation, and high-score tracking.

projects.name: mypaint
projects.title: myPaint — 2D Raster Graphics & Canvas Editor
projects.summary: GUI drawing application featuring modular tool palettes, layer manipulation, custom brush dynamics, and color selection.

projects.name: myradar
projects.title: myRadar — Real-Time Air Traffic Radar & Collision Simulation
projects.summary: 2D Air traffic control simulation visualizing flight trajectories, control tower radii, and real-time aircraft collision detection using spatial Quadtree partitioning.

projects.name: myrpg
projects.title: myRPG — 2D Role-Playing Game Engine & Real-Time Event Loop
projects.summary: myRPG is an interactive role-playing game developed from first principles in C. The architecture isolates the rendering loop, input handling, entity management, and user interface layers, delivering smooth 60 FPS performance with custom particle emitters and modular dialogue systems.

projects.name: myworld
projects.title: myWorld — 3D Isometric Terrain Modeling & Heightmap Engine
projects.summary: myWorld allows users to generate, visualize, and sculpt three-dimensional terrain maps in real time. It calculates mathematical projections to transform 3D grid vertices into a 2D isometric viewport, providing intuitive elevation controls and texture mapping.

projects.name: relativistic-raytracer
projects.title: Relativistic Raytracer — Curved Spacetime Geodesic Engine
projects.summary: Optical raytracing simulation modeling photon trajectories along null geodesics in curved spacetime metrics (Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes) using numerical differential integrators.

projects.name: rtype
projects.title: R-Type — Cross-Platform Multiplayer Networked Game Engine (ECS)
projects.summary: R-Type replicates the classic side-scrolling arcade shooter as a distributed, networked multiplayer platform. The engine is architected around an in-house Entity-Component-System (ECS) model to ensure deterministic game state updates, high cache locality, and scalable concurrency across client and server runtimes.

projects.name: screensaver
projects.title: MyScreensaver — Real-Time Procedural Graphics Animation
projects.summary: Modular real-time screensaver rendering procedural visual animations, trigonometric waves, and particle physics in CSFML.

projects.name: tekspice
projects.title: TekSpice — Discrete Electronic & Digital Logic Circuit Simulator
projects.summary: Object-oriented discrete electronic component and digital logic circuit simulation engine in C++20. Parses Netlist component topologies and evaluates cyclic graph state propagation across discrete clock cycles.

projects.name: tetris
projects.title: Tetris — Terminal Grid Engine & NCurses Event Loop
projects.summary: This implementation features a robust terminal UI engine running in raw terminal mode, completely detached from line buffering. It dynamically loads external tetromino shape definition files, validates geometries, and drives standard game mechanics (rotation, line clears, score scaling, speed ramping).

projects.name: 42sh
projects.title: 42sh — POSIX-Compliant Unix Shell Architecture
projects.summary: Complete Unix command language interpreter engineered in C. Features Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) lexical parsing, multi-process pipeline orchestration, signal handling, and interactive terminal job control.

projects.name: asm-minilibc
projects.title: ASM MiniLibC — Pure x86-64 Low-Level Assembly Primitives
projects.summary: Clean-room implementation of standard C library memory and string primitives written entirely in pure x86-64 assembly, strictly adhering to the System V AMD64 ABI specification.

projects.name: corewar
projects.title: Corewar — Virtual Machine, Bytecode Assembler & Memory Arena
projects.summary: Corewar is composed of two primary subsystems:

projects.name: ftrace
projects.title: ftrace — Dynamic Function Call & Call Graph Tracer
projects.summary: Process execution tracer capturing user-space function calls, shared library jumps, and system call boundaries using runtime software breakpoints and symbol resolution.

projects.name: minishell1
projects.title: Minishell 1 — Unix Process Lifecycle & Command Interpreter
projects.summary: Fundamental Unix shell engine handling user input tokenization, child process execution lifecycle, PATH resolution, and built-in commands.

projects.name: minishell2
projects.title: Minishell 2 — Multi-Stage Unix Process & Pipe Orchestrator
projects.summary: Advanced Unix command interpreter supporting inter-process communication pipelines, file descriptor redirection, and persistent environment variable management.

projects.name: my-ls
projects.title: my_ls — POSIX Directory Stream & File Metadata Lister
projects.summary: High-performance directory listing utility reproducing GNU `ls` behavior. Queries filesystem metadata, formats permissions, file owners, modification timestamps, and directory hierarchies.

projects.name: my-printf
projects.title: my_printf — Zero-Allocation Formatted Output Engine
projects.summary: Complete reimplementation of the standard C library `printf` formatted I/O function, handling variadic argument lists with custom buffer management.

projects.name: navy
projects.title: Navy — Inter-Process Terminal Battleship via POSIX Signals
projects.summary: Terminal-based multiplayer Battleship game communicating strictly through POSIX user signals (`SIGUSR1` and `SIGUSR2`) without network sockets or pipes.

projects.name: nm-objdump
projects.title: nm & objdump — ELF64 Binary Format Introspector
projects.summary: Binary inspection toolchain analyzing Executable and Linkable Format (ELF64) files. Decodes section headers, symbol tables (`.symtab`), string tables (`.strtab`), and memory segment layouts.

projects.name: strace
projects.title: strace — Linux System Call Interception & Tracing Engine
projects.summary: Native Linux binary introspection utility intercepting kernel system calls, signal deliveries, and process state transitions using `ptrace(2)` and ELF64 architecture inspection.
